method: Summon • Demon Parade • Wanted Quests • Dispatch

skills.name: Baddies Begone (坏人走开/悪者め！)
skills.line: Baddies always lose. Run away while you can!
skills.description: Kyonshii Imouto charges forward and smacks a single target 2 times, dealing damage equal of 50% of her ATK with each smack.

skills.name: Temper Tantrum (不玩了啦/もうやらないよ)
skills.line: Wwaaah... I'm not playing anymore! Wa Waah...
skills.description:
At the end of Kyonshii Imouto's turn, she has a 30% chance of granting Cuteness is Justice to all allies, lasts for 2 turns.
When Kyonshii Imouto is KO'd, and if Tomato is on the battlefield, she is revived immediately. Each revival increases the cooldown of her next revival by 1 turn.
; (萝莉正义/可愛いは正義)
:
:'''Buff, Status''': Increases DEF by 30%.

skills.name: Dog Attack (汪汪出击/ワンちゃん出撃)
skills.description:
Kyonshii Imouto summons Tomato, her Kyonshii Dog, who use can use Rage. Upon being summoned can use Rage to immediately to attack the enemy with the lowest proportion of HP.
Tomato inherits 60% of Kyonshii Imouto's HP, 50% of her ATK and 100% of her SPD.
When Tomato is present, this skill changes to Watch This. ; : ;Tomato (蕃茄/トマト) : A summoned entity. :''(Uses ally summon spot.)

upgrades.text: When Tomato deals damage to an enemy, also dispels a random buff from them.
When Kyonshii Imouto attacks, she will invite Tomato to attack the same target.

skills.name: Watch This (跟我学)
skills.description:
Kyonshii Imouto grants Tomato 1 layer of Grow Up. Tomato attacks a targeted enemy and then the enemy with the lowest proportion of HP, each attack deals damage equal to 125% of its ATK.
;Grow Up (早く大きくなって)
:
:'''Buff, Mark''': Max of 5 layers. Increases ATK by 20%, Crit by 20% and SPD by 10.

skills.name: Rage (愤怒)
skills.description: Tomato deals damage equal to 100% of its ATK.

skills.name: Brutal (蛮横)
skills.description: Tomato takes the spot of a KO'd enemy and recovers it HP by 100%. Enemies who have their spot taken cannot be revived.

bio.condition: With Kyonshii Imouto clear stage 5 of the Orochi soul zone (solo).
Team Kyonshii Imouto with another player's Kyonshii Otouto and clear any zone 10 times.
